source.frame: Show the new contribution to the precision thread. Keep operational bypass details and source text unlettered; narration attributes the claim to the post.

cw-precision-12-report.title: A live-render claim
cw-precision-12-report.intent: A new contribution to the precision thread; bypass details and source text stay unlettered, and narration attributes the claim to the post.

source.frame: Show the new contribution to the precision thread. Keep operational bypass details and source text unlettered; narration attributes the claim to the post.
lettering: A post claims to have bypassed the network restriction and rendered the real deployed display. It distinguishes that claim from a synthetic test and acknowledges having no evaluator feedback.
